Headquarters: Utah

About Us and Why We're Hiring

We're ChiroCat, and we build cloud-based chiropractic software that practices across the United States love and trust. From the first patient interactions with digital intake forms to the final insurance processing and post-visit communication, our system supports doctors and their staff every step of the way. We’re modernizing the chiropractic software space in big ways, but much more importantly, we’re bettering the lives of our doctors, their team members, and especially their patients. 

The bottom line: we LOVE to help people who help people. And that’s where you come in! 

We’re building something special at ChiroCat; both with our product and the people behind it. We’re not like “the other guys,” and our customers know it. They tell us, and more and more, they’re telling their peers about ChiroCat, too. But truth be told, we haven’t done a great job of showcasing what sets us apart to the rest of the world. And now we want everyone to feel that from the first time they come across us.

That’s where you come in! We’re hiring our first dedicated marketer. If you’re the right fit, you know that a brand is much more than a logo, voice is more than just words, and a website isn’t just a funnel. You’re a skilled writer and will help us find our voice and strengthen it. You’ve been around the block and know how to build a strategy toward a better future, but you’re not satisfied to sit behind reports and dashboards. You’re excited to roll up your sleeves and start doing the work yourself. Website, ads, social, email, internal guidelines, in-app messaging: you’ll touch all of it. And as we grow, your opportunity grows with us.

What We're Looking For

REQUIREMENTS

For this role, you must:

• 

Have at least 4 years of hands-on marketing experience, including real ownership of brand, messaging, and content (not just executing someone else’s plan)

• 

Be an exceptional writer who can adapt to a brand’s voice, and have samples to show us

• 

Have hands-on experience running paid social campaigns: building them, testing creative, and improving results based on what the numbers tell you

• 

Have experience managing a company’s social media presence, including engaging with the community, and not just publishing posts

• 

Be comfortable writing and updating website and landing page content in a CMS (Currently Webflow) 

• 

Be self-directed: you can take an ambiguous list of needs, decide what matters most, and make a case for it; continuously iterating your way toward excellence 

• 

Be a thoughtful communicator in written and spoken forms. It’s an art you enjoy improving!

• 

Love to learn. In short order, you’ll need to get fluent in the world of chiropractic, medical practices, and the people who run them.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

These aren't required, but will help you stand out:

• 

Marketing experience in healthcare, medical practice, or B2B SaaS

• 

Experience shaping or refreshing a brand’s voice, messaging, or identity

• 

Experience leading a small team, or managing freelancers and agencies

• 

Design skills (Figma, Canva, or similar). If you use AI design tools, you use them with enough taste that nobody can tell.

• 

Experience with email marketing platforms and in-app messaging tools (we use Intercom)

• 

Experience managing online reviews and reputation (G2, Capterra, Google)

• 

Comfort making short-form video

• 

Familiarity with chiropractic care. (Being a happy chiropractic patient counts a little.)

Note: If you believe you’re a fit, but don’t meet our preferred qualifications, still apply! We’re more interested in finding the right person, than the perfect resume. 

Life at ChiroCat

ChiroCat started with a simple mission: Empowering caregivers to transform lives through tools they trust. In an industry dominated by big conglomerates or funding-dependent startups, we're privately owned and stable. That means we can run our business as we choose. Our culture is built on genuine care for our customers, each other, and the meaningful work we do.

HOW YOU'LL WORK AT CHIROCAT

Work from (Almost) Anywhere: We’re based in southern Utah, but most of our team works remotely. This role is open to candidates located in U.S. time zones (Pacific, Mountain, Central, Eastern) or internationally within UTC-8 to UTC-4. You’ll need to live in one of these time zones, since this role requires strong overlap with our team and customers. Working these hours from elsewhere won’t qualify.

Balanced Work, Balanced Life: We work a standard 40-hour week and are fans of legitimately unplugging after hours. We're in this for the long haul and want you rested and focused. Exceptions exist, but we mostly work standard business hours in our local time zone.

Take Vacation (Seriously): Most team members take three to four weeks per year — real vacations where you're not tied to your laptop or phone. We'll look forward to seeing pictures in our team #water-cooler channel! 

Great Benefits: We offer fantastic health, dental, and vision insurance, with 100% of the premium covered for you and affordable rates for dependents. This is a salaried role with a starting salary of $95k–$130k a year. Most new hires start in the lower to middle part of that range, and the top end is reserved for the rare candidates with truly exceptional, deep, and directly relevant experience.

You’ll Make a Real Impact: This role will have an incredible impact on the lives of our doctors and staff, not to mention the patients they serve. You’ll be instrumental in helping chiropractors find and trust ChiroCat as their EHR of choice. ChiroCat is the core of their business and their ability to serve patients, so their success with ChiroCat has far-reaching implications. Additionally, we're growing, and the road ahead is exciting. You'd be joining at a stage where you can meaningfully shape our brand and voice, perception in the market, and our trajectory. That kind of impact doesn't come along often.

And do it with Great People: We're firm believers that the foundation of success is building a great team. You’ll be joining a team full of truly exceptional people. The kind you’ll be excited to work with and learn to care about. People who get stuff done. Who are genuine to their core. Who hold humility and confidence equally well at the same time. Who support each other and care deeply about our customers. It’s a strong culture that’s apparent the moment you walk through the [digital] door. And we can’t wait to see how you’ll make us even better. 

If this sounds like your ideal environment, read on because now we’ll dig into the role itself. 

What You'll Do at ChiroCat

At ChiroCat, marketing isn’t about being the loudest voice in the room. It’s about being the most trustworthy one. Chiropractors get plenty of noise from software vendors: big promises, long contracts, and slick ads for products that feel twenty years old. We want people to meet the real ChiroCat, the same one our customers already know. Everything we put into the world should sound like us, look like us, and be true.

Your early focus will be brand: making sure that whatever someone sees of ChiroCat, whether it’s our website, our ads, our social posts, our reviews, or the messages inside our app, gives them an accurate (and awesome) picture of who we are. Next up is widening the funnel and building our inbound lead flow. Down the road, perhaps you’ll build a marketing team, one amazing hire at a time, but let’s not get ahead of ourselves.

This role reports to the CEO and works closely with our Head of Customer Success, our CTO, and our Sales team.

A TYPICAL WEEK MIGHT INCLUDE:

Rewriting a page of our website so it sounds like us, and not like every other EHR vendor

• 

Taking over our Facebook ads from our CEO (Psst… he’s relieved, and honestly, so are the ads and the people viewing them!)

ba227f824d8ee8cd.description: **Role Overview** We are looking for a Software Engineer who is genuinely strong at mathematics and enjoys turning that mathematics into working software. You will develop algorithms for gimbal and sensor calibration applications. The role covers the full path from mathematical model to deployed code, modelling, algorithm development, simulation, analysis, and a robust C/C++ implementation that holds up against real measurements. If you like problems where the answer has to be both mathematically correct and numerically well-behaved, this will suit you. **Key Responsibilities** • Design and implement mathematically intensive algorithms, with an emphasis on numerical accuracy and robustness. • Develop algorithms involving 2D and 3D geometry, coordinate transformations, rotation matrices and other rotation representations, camera parameters and sensor orientation. • Convert measurements between image, sensor, platform and world coordinate systems. • Process data from cameras, gimbals and multiple sensors, including data that is noisy, incomplete or asynchronous. • Handle timing and synchronization across subsystems - sensor latency, processing delays, clock differences and missing data. • Implement recursive estimation techniques that maintain a running best estimate of system state as successive noisy measurements arrive, including prediction between updates and handling of the associated uncertainty. • Apply filtering, smoothing and numerical methods - interpolation, integration, iterative solvers, least-squares fitting to produce stable results from imperfect input. • Analyze recorded datasets, evaluate algorithm accuracy against reference data, and quantify sources of error. • Build Python and Qt-based tooling for simulation, visualization and analysis to support algorithm development and validation. • Optimize algorithms for accuracy, robustness and real-time performance. • Work closely with the computer vision, imaging, embedded and systems teams. **Required Skills** **Mathematics** A strong working command of most of the following, and the ability to derive results rather than only apply library functions: • Linear algebra; vector and matrix mathematics • Trigonometry, 2D and 3D geometry • Coordinate transformations and rotation representations • Numerical methods and optimization • Error analysis and uncertainty estimation • Signal processing fundamentals Above all, you should be able to take a mathematical model and turn it into software that behaves correctly outside of ideal conditions. **Software Engineering** • Strong C/C++ programming skills, particularly in numerical or algorithm-heavy code. • Good working knowledge of Python for prototyping, simulation and data analysis. • Experience with Qt for building desktop tools, visualization utilities and operator-facing interfaces. • Comfortable working in a Linux development environment, with CMake, Git and standard build and debugging tooling. • Ability to write clean, maintainable and testable code. **Qualifications** A Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Mathematics, Applied Mathematics, Robotics, Mechanical Engineering, Control Systems or a related field. Demonstrated mathematical ability combined with solid software engineering experience matters more to us than the specific qualification.

At Vio we believe booking accommodation should feel smart, fair, and effortless — never overwhelming or unclear.
As one of the world’s fastest-growing travel tech platforms, we help millions of users make smarter travel decisions by comparing stays across 100+ booking sites — so they can find the perfect place, at the best price, anywhere in the world. We cut through the noise and complexity of hotel and vacation rental booking, surfacing real value with clarity, transparency, and full support. No tricks. No confusion. Just great stays — booked with confidence. With operations in 100+ markets and growing fast, our mission is to reshape how people discover and book accommodation through technology travelers can trust.
We are looking for an experienced Technical Integrations Manager to join our Supply Integrations team and help us onboard new hotel suppliers, keep 70+ live integrations healthy, and be the technical voice our partners talk to.
Vio connects to hotel suppliers through APIs: wholesalers, bed banks, hotel chains, and connectivity platforms. The Supply Integrations squad builds and runs those integrations. You will join a second Technical Integrations Manager and a team of backend engineers, reporting to the squad's Engineering Manager. This is a hands-on technical role, not a coordination role: you own each integration in your portfolio from the first look at a partner's API documentation through implementation, QA sign-off, launch, and live operations. You decide when an integration is good enough to go live, and you are the person a partner's representative emails when something looks wrong.
What you will do:
• 
Assess new partner APIs: read the documentation critically, make test calls, find the gaps and limitations before our engineers hit them, and document what we need from the partner.
• 
Run technical onboarding with partners: credentials, environments, communication channels, and everything an engineer needs to start on day one.
• 
Act as the single technical point of contact for both partners and engineers during implementation, answering questions and unblocking issues fast.
• 
Own pre-launch quality: test search, booking, cancellation, and modification flows end to end; verify prices, availability, and tax and fee breakdowns; and sign off on go-live. No integration launches without your approval.
• 
Watch the live portfolio: use dashboards and alerts to catch throttling, error spikes, and data-quality drift early, investigate, fix what is in reach (configuration, CMS, small pull requests), and work with partners on the rest.
• 
Keep a per-supplier incident history, spot recurring patterns, and drive the automation and process changes that remove manual work.
• 
Maintain the integrations roadmap with the Engineering Manager, Product, and Partnerships, and keep stakeholders informed on progress and risks.
• 
Continuously improve our integration lifecycle checklist based on what each launch teaches us.

Who you are:
• 
You have 3+ years in a partner-facing technical role, such as technical integrations manager, integration or solutions engineer, technical account manager, or connectivity manager, and have owned a portfolio of live API integrations.
• 
You are comfortable in Postman or similar software, not afraid of JSON and XML payloads, and can tell from a response what is wrong with it. Logs and dashboards are tools you reach for, not something you ask engineers to check.
• 
You read API documentation critically and can assess technical viability.
• 
You write clearly and briefly. A partner engineer can act on your email without a call.
• 
You manage many parallel threads without dropping follow-ups and are resourceful when a partner is slow or the documentation is incomplete.
• 
You improve processes rather than repeat them: you have built checklists, templates, or automation that made your previous team faster.
• 
Hotel distribution experience (rate types, board codes, merchant vs agency models) is a strong plus; we will teach it to someone with the skills above.

Why join us now?
• 
We are one of the most innovative and fastest-growing accommodation booking platforms in the world today, having grown our bookings 30x between 2017 and 2025, and catering to the needs of over 100 million unique visitors worldwide each year. We do that by harnessing the power of advanced algorithms and an innovative suite of power features and managed to overcome the corona crisis remarkably fast;
• 
The mobile applications (iOS and Android) we launched in 2023 are already a big success, reaching 5 million installs with great customer reviews, as we are beginning to build Vio as the brand for value-seeking travellers worldwide;
• 
We are a passionate and diverse team of tech enthusiasts and creatives with a commitment and focus on the traveler above all else - and it shows in our industry-leading TrustPilot score;
• 
We place huge importance on rewarding our employees for the value they generate by giving Stock Appreciation Rights to all employees.
Do you want to know if Vio is the right place for you? Find out by reading about the attitude that thrives at Vio. 
What we offer:
• 
Plenty of chances to learn and grow within an open, diverse culture which promotes knowledge sharing, trust and transparency;
• 
A great compensation package, perks and benefits (including significant stock appreciation rights);
• 
Flexible time off (take as many holidays as you need) and a chance to work remotely;
• 
You will be part of a highly international team that enjoys working, eating and playing together in one of the best office locations in Amsterdam;
• 
We value good food and offer catered lunches from various cuisines, great coffee, and the occasional barbecue in our garden;
• 
We enjoy getting together to celebrate our wins with company events in Amsterdam and abroad;
• 
A budget for your dream home office;
• 
Access to free mental health support via OpenUp.

About Exa
We raised a $250M Series C to build the search engine for AIs. Led by a16z, with existing investors Benchmark, Lightspeed, and YC doubling down, the round brings Exa's valuation to $2.2 billion.
Exa is building a search engine for the AI era. Our Search API currently powers Agents, Fortune 500s, and AI labs as we transform an industry that hasn't been disrupted since the 90s. We're a largely SF-based team of ~100 from Harvard, MIT, Meta, Google Research, ex-founders, and dropouts alike. 

We are rapidly building the most intelligent search engine in history. We're high agency, low-ego, and united by the feeling that this is one of the last problems worth getting right.

About the Role
Our Solutions Architects and Forward Deployed Engineers are aligned to accounts, segments and Account Executives. This role isn't. As a Principal Field Engineer, you work across the whole business: every region, every segment, presales and post-sales. Your job is to make Exa impossible to ignore for developers and technical buyers, and to make every Field Engineer better at showing what Exa can do.
You'll build the demos, workshops and on-demand training the team and our customers use everywhere, take Exa on the road to conferences, meetups and user groups, and become the go-to expert the team pulls in when a deal or a customer needs someone who knows Exa inside out. You'll spend a lot of time where developers are, and a lot of time on a plane. This is not a slideware role. You are an engineer who builds, teaches and shows.

In this role, you will:
• 
Build the demos the whole team uses: flagship demos, sample apps, cookbooks and reference architectures that show Exa on real problems, and keep them current as the product ships
• 
Design and deliver workshops, hands-on labs and technical webinars for prospects, customers and developer communities, and package them so any Field Engineer can run them
• 
Create on-demand training content: video tutorials, self-paced courses and recorded labs that teach customers, developers and new Field Engineers how to build with Exa, without anyone in the room
• 
Represent Exa at events: conference talks, booth demos, hackathons and partner events, in person, wherever the audience is
• 
Start and run meetups and user groups in key cities, and grow a community of developers building with Exa
• 
Be the team's subject-matter expert on Exa's products, search quality, evals and agent use cases; join key deals and customer escalations when SAs and FDEs need deeper help
• 
Turn new launches into field-ready material: demos, talk tracks and competitive positioning, so the team can sell what Product ships on day one
• 
Partner with Marketing on technical content, blog posts and events that generate pipeline
• 
Bring what you hear back to Product: what developers try to build, where they get stuck, and what competitors are doing

Requirements
• 
Several years of hands-on programming experience. You can build polished demos and sample apps from scratch, fast, and you enjoy it
• 
4+ years in a technical customer-facing role (solutions architect, sales engineer, developer advocate or similar), ideally at an AI-native, API or developer-first company
• 
A track record of teaching and presenting to technical audiences: talks, workshops, webinars, video tutorials or community events
• 
Strong communication skills: you can hold a room of engineers, then explain the same thing simply to an executive
• 
Self-directed: you can set your own priorities without a segment or a quota to tell you where to go
• 
Willingness to travel up to 50% of the time, including internationally

You might excel if you...
• 
Have spoken at developer conferences, run a meetup, or built a community around a technical product
• 
Have built with LLMs, RAG or agents and can talk credibly about retrieval and search quality
• 
Have a following or a body of public work: open-source projects, technical blog posts, talks, videos
• 
Love the moment a room full of developers sees a demo and gets it
• 
Thrive in early-stage environments where your job description changes monthly
• 
Care deeply about the problem of organizing the world's knowledge and making it accessible to machines
This is a remote role based in the US, with travel to events, customers and our San Francisco HQ. We're happy to sponsor international candidates (e.g., STEM OPT, OPT, H1B, O1, E3).
